description: Repairs r-str-ado-act/ado-rs-cursors: the connection ran in read mode (Mode = 1), so effective LockType and Supports were confounded. On a read-write ACE connection (own copy of r-fix-wire-ado-ado5), for eight (CursorLocation, CursorType, LockType, Options, source) requests: server forward-only read-only, keyset optimistic, dynamic pessimistic, static read-only, client static batch-optimistic, client forward-only read-only, adCmdTable keyset read-only on K and adCmdTableDirect keyset read-only on K; read effective CursorType, LockType, CursorLocation, State, RecordCount, CacheSize, BOF, EOF, every Supports option, then MoveLast, AbsolutePosition and RecordCount, then Close, with Connection.Errors read and cleared after each recordset. Asks the requested versus effective tuple and the supported options on a writable connection.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
